decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the character of the building and the visual amenity of the area. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and ENV.1.12 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan, policies ENV.B.1.1 and ENV-B1.7 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and the provisions of Planning Policy Guidance Note 8 - Telecommunications.
description: Installation of 3 antennas, 2 no. pole mounted (on existing poles), 1 antenna to be attached to plant room and 1 antenna and microwave dish to be pole mounted to plant room on roof of existing block of flats.
